verdict.rationale: Checkout.com ships official SDKs: an official Node.js server SDK on GitHub, plus first-party native iOS and Android Mobile SDKs for building checkout experiences. That covers the core of building against official SDKs, but the evidence for each is a single thin line. Missing for 10: evidence of server SDKs in languages beyond Node.js, in-depth SDK reference docs or usage guides, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
